explanation:
Implement only restage from the actual frame-396 state. Preserve the completed raise and transfer, retire the interrupted residual target, and first measure the achieved approach rather than replaying a command. Compare independently identified visible carton end landmarks and its fitted face with actual hand motion since the frame-324 baseline. Fresh high-resolution bowl lip measurements can replace the older opening uncertainty; independent known bowl landmarks are an alternative when lip depth is unavailable. No tracker or hidden-corner recovery is required.

If the achieved pose already supports the unchanged 3.5 mm fit margin and an above-rim opening option, finish without motion. Otherwise permit at most one reviewed, 15 mm higher, object-centered recenter/attitude action at the new workspace, followed by fresh differential and geometric effect checks. Never repeat either old tilt or stalled residual corrections. No descent, opening, release, settling test or later-stage control is included.
interface:
Complete Python main(api), using the exact supplied runtime, np, math and geo. Returns JSON-compatible stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. Reads and overwrites only restage.reference and restage.progress because all sixteen checkpoint slots are occupied. Compact references retain dimension/source provenance, physical identities, frame-324 object/bowl/hand baselines, valid partial measurements and latest observation-frame models. Progress preserves the retired command, acknowledged state changes since its checkpoint, earlier receipts, new pending action, actual whole-lease states and effect evidence. Handoff contains checkpoint meanings, frames, assumptions and a measured above-rim option, not future control code.

At most three declared-schema reviews: up to two different initial measurements and one post-action review. At most one api.drive lease, capped at eighteen calls and fifty-four native steps; control slices do not cause a program-authored yield. All measurement failures are checked before geometry. Missing evidence returns blocked, changed retention/bowl or renewed divergence returns needs_replan, and an observation stop returns abort. Stage completion requires fresh retained-carton displacement, unchanged uncertainty-adjusted fit, above-rim reserves and a visible local opening corridor. It never proposes whole-task completion.
jev_protocol:
The seven control questions explicitly bind x, y, z, rx, ry and rz to their respective state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation fields. Positive means increasing the indicated world coordinate or world rotation-vector component; negative means decreasing it; hold means the supplied deadband. The gripper question reads state.processed_features.objective.gripper: open requests opening, close requests continued closure, and keep preserves the previous command. This method requests close exclusively. Every physical update uses api.drive and real Jev, with unchanged choices dispatched by the host. Program features supply the action phase, observation frame, carton/bowl uncertainties, 3.5 mm required fit margin, planned rise/tilt, sweep reserve and prohibition on release. The host supplies current hand residuals; Jev neither calculates metric geometry nor supplies visual or grasp evidence.

Numerical geometry uses measured depth, calibrated plane rays and supplied geo helpers. Fit subtracts both measurement uncertainties, the unchanged 1.5 mm position tolerance, and the measured hand-to-carton lever times the 0.015 rad rotation tolerance. Feature coverage is compared with residual/noise to bound orientation uncertainty, not an absolute patch-size gate. The local sweep is checked at the lowest planned hand height across the candidate rotation so it does not assume synchronous translation and rotation. A bounded local visual route check covers other visible bodies; none of these checks certify hidden clearance.

The lease stops on reached, repeated stalls or its finite cap. Its before/after receipt is not used as whole-lease motion; actual states are saved separately. A nonreached tail is never retried or relabeled as pose convergence. It can support stage completion only if the whole lease made useful nondivergent progress and fresh measured geometry independently passes the unchanged effect tests. geo.attachment_error compares observed corresponding carton endpoints against the measured TCP transform, with an independent face-normal check and motion greater than twice the measurement allowance. Closure or tracking alone cannot establish retention. Geometry is marked stale immediately after motion and reacquired before reuse. Invalid measurements receive only a bounded different view/patch or bowl-measurement alternative; an unresolved exact gap requests supervision. The prospective 20 mm per-side jaw corridor is not a measured open state or an assumed hardware travel limit, and release remains unauthorized.
